+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_run_bash_logs_warning_on_failure(tmp_path, caplog):
+    # Ensure the command will fail (exit code 1)
+    result_json = await run_bash(
+        "exit 1",
+        output_dir=tmp_path,
+        timeout_seconds=5,
+        max_output_bytes=1000,
+    )
+    result = json.loads(result_json)
+    assert result["exit_code"] == 1

+    warnings = [rec for rec in caplog.records if rec.levelname == "WARNING"]
